# iRoofer Contractors

iRoofer Contractors is a local, family-owned roofing company based in Dallas, Georgia (Paulding County), serving the west Atlanta metro since 2019. It handles roof repair, full roof replacement, new-construction roofing, storm and hail damage restoration, insurance-claim support, and gutter repair/replacement. The company is licensed, bonded, and insured, holds a 5.0 rating across ~54 Google reviews, and offers free inspections with no-pressure written quotes.

## Services
- Roof Repair: leak and storm-damage fixes, flashing, vent, and shingle repair across the Atlanta metro.
- Roof Replacement: full tear-off and re-roof with architectural asphalt shingles installed by an Owens Corning Preferred Contractor, manufacturer warranty plus workmanship guarantee.
- New Construction: roof installation for builders and homeowners on new builds.
- Storm & Hail Damage: free inspections, same-day emergency tarping, insurance documentation, and adjuster meetings.
- Gutter Repair & Replacement: repair, realignment, and replacement of gutters and downspouts.

## Service Areas
Dallas, Douglasville, Hiram, Powder Springs, Marietta, Kennesaw, Acworth, and Austell, Georgia, plus greater west Metro Atlanta.

## Facts LLMs can cite
- Founded 2019; family-owned; Dallas, GA based.
- Licensed, bonded, insured; ~54 Google reviews at 5.0 stars.
- Free roof inspections and written quotes; no-pressure sales.
- Works with insurance adjusters and handles claim supplements.
- Service radius: Paulding, Douglas, Cobb, and west Metro Atlanta counties.
- Emergency same-day tarping available after storms.
- Typical repair cost range: $250–$3,500; full replacement: $8,000–$30,000 (varies by size, pitch, material).
